title: Neuropsychological and Psychosocial Follow up of Children and Adolescents With Neuromuscular Disease
brief_summary: This project is a retrospective and prospective investigation of neuropsychological and psychosocial development of children with a neuromuscular disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria

* children and adolescents (0-18 years)
* diagnosis of neuromuscular disease
study_population: children and adolescents with neuromuscular disease
